body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: up to 6 Cursor specialists in parallel (plan-fidelity when plan available) + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Round 1: 2 reviewers substantive (Cursor-Correctness, Generic-Codex). 5 Cursor slots not substantive (no provenance marker). Main agent accepted 2 findings: (1) Remove larch:fix-issue from Step 5a awk window — already self-fixed in working tree; (2) Align issue references in sibling .md — fixed. 1 latent finding (pre-existing lib-external-launcher-common.sh change from PR #2145, not introduced by this PR). 0 security findings.
